about_the_game:
Space Dash is a fast-paced, click-to-dash action game where every move is an explosion. Dash across the battlefield, collide with swarms of rock-like enemies, and unleash devastating area damage. Each rock shattered rewards you with gold, which fuels a massive skill tree that lets you grow stronger, deadlier, and more creative with every run.

From quick tactical dashes to galaxy-shaking upgrades, your choices define how the chaos unfolds. Will you focus on raw damage, expand your blast radius, bend gravity to your will, or unleash turrets and missile barrages to cover the screen in firepower?

Key Features

  • Explosive Dash Combat – Click anywhere to instantly dash and create a destructive shockwave, damaging every enemy caught in the blast.

  • Rock Enemies & Bosses – Face off against waves of stone-like foes and massive boss rocks with unique challenges and higher gold multipliers.

  • Gravity Pull Mechanic – Activate a powerful ability that drags enemies into a cluster, setting up perfect dashes for maximum carnage.

  • Turrets & Missile Strikes – Deploy helpful turrets and unlock dash-triggered missile barrages that rain destruction across the arena.

  • Deep Skill Tree Progression – Spend gold to unlock hundreds of upgrades: boost dash damage, expand explosion radius, increase enemy density for bigger rewards, improve missile chance and turret power, and more.

  • Fast-Paced Runs – Quick, action-packed sessions that keep you coming back for “just one more upgrade.”
